content:
UntranslatedItems - 流体与化学物质同样支持！

这是一个UntranslatedItems的扩展模组，能将Minecraft模组新增的液体以及Mekanism模组的气体也变为未翻译状态。
An addon of UntranslatedItems, that also makes fluids and chemicals from mekanism mod untranslated!

本模组受UntranslatedItems-AlsoFluids启发而制作。向KatatsumuriPan致以崇高敬意！
This mod is inspired by UntranslatedItems-AlsoFluids. Great respect for KatatsumuriPan!

各版本及外部模组支持 (Minecraft versions and external mods support)

当前支持的Minecraft版本、模组加载器版本以及外部模组如下： Currently supported Minecraft/modLoader versions and external mods are as follows.

Minecraft 模组加载器(modLoader) 支持的外部模组(supported external mods)
1.21.1 neoforge Mekanism,EMI,Jade,AE2,AppliedMekanistics,GregTechCEu
1.20.4 neoforge Mekanism,EMI,Jade,AE2,AppliedMekanistics
1.20.1 forge Mekanism,JEI,Jade,AE2,AppliedMekanistics,GregTechCEu
其他(others) 暂不支持(unsupported) 暂不支持(unsupported)

如需支持其他版本或其他外部模组，请在issue中提出。
（全部自行维护过于困难，因此只支持有需求的部分）
If you want other minecraft versions, other modLoader, or other external mods support, please open issue.
(It's hard to support all versions independently, so I'll support the ones in demand.)

许可协议 (License)

本模组基于LGPL v2.1协议发布。
This mod is released under LGPL v2.1.
